|errata_history=This is the errata version PC-E1 (version 2 of 6) of the Virtual Modern card. It is not the current version; the current version is [[Aayla Secura (Holo AI) (Errata 5)]] (PC-E5). The image is the Players Committee card image of this version ([[:File:V0-L-aaylasecura_ai-2019-02-11.gif]]). Each version below is a published PC card image; dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository (each image proves its text existed then; the errata may have been announced a few days later). Card images that changed in any visible way are separate versions (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). '''What changed on the card image''' (crops of the two published images, pixels unchanged): [[File:V0-L-aaylasecura_ai-2019-02-11-change-before.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] before ([[:File:V0-L-aaylasecura_ai-2018-07-08.gif]], 8 July 2018) → [[File:V0-L-aaylasecura_ai-2019-02-11-change-after.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] after ([[:File:V0-L-aaylasecura_ai-2019-02-11.gif]], 11 February 2019).
* '''Original''' ([[Aayla Secura (Holo AI)]]): PC card image uploaded by 8 July 2018<ref name="img-aaylasecura_ai022435b">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual0-Light/large/aaylasecurah.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 commit 022435b] (by 8 July 2018); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual0-Light/large/aaylasecurah.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref> (earliest copy found: the first commit of the repository; the card was printed earlier and no earlier image of it was found). May not be targeted by weapons unless each of your other aliens and clones present are 'hit.' Immune to You Are Beaten and attrition < 5.”
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): PC card image uploaded 11 February 2019<ref name="img-aaylasecura_ai3d6a28d">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual0-Light/large/aaylasecurah.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/3d6a28de79744f577eda610c619c9f6723ba7042 commit 3d6a28d] (11 February 2019); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual0-Light/large/aaylasecurah.gif (today's copy is the latest version only).
